name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3352: Total fixed-size source windows 50 to 43 against a ceiling of 44, so BOTH ratchets are green for the first time in this arc: silent 0 of 2, total 43 of 44. Seven more windows in test_the_shelf_tabs_are_the_real_sessions now end where their subject ends, using the brace-balanced _fn_body rather than a byte count - the remainder guard, the empty-on-this-shelf branch, _reopenClear, _shDismiss, the closed-stage branch, and both halves of the refusal panel. THE HELPER ITSELF HAD TO LEARN ONE THING: an anchor may legitimately OPEN with a closing brace - the else-if branch head in this file does - and balancing from character zero drives depth to -1 before any opening brace is seen, so the walk never returns to zero and the helper reports cannot-bound for a block it can see perfectly well. It now starts counting at the first opening brace at or after the anchor while the RETURNED span still begins at the anchor, so the caller reads the branch head it asked for. AND CLOSING THE RATCHET MADE ITS OWN LAW PROVABLE: test_a_source_window_must_reach_its_subject was UNPROVABLE at v3350 and v3351 - already red untampered, so nothing could be demonstrated - and it now PROVES. A law that is already failing cannot be shown to fail for the RIGHT reason, which is why a red that sits is worse than a red that gets fixed. HEADROOM IS ONE: the next fixed-size window added turns this red again, and that is the honest state rather than a comfortable one. THE INSTRUMENT STILL OVER-COUNTS AND THAT IS CARRIED, NOT HIDDEN: the detector counts ANY slice measured from its own start, so ordinary algorithmic slicing is charged as a source-window guess - proven non-source by what CONSUMES the slice are a histogram sum in chronicle_retro and an n-gram join in g5_grok_eyes. Excluding them needs AST flow analysis and its own version; doing it on a keyword heuristic would be re-blessing a ratchet with extra steps. 475 gates, 4 red-proofs PROVEN, 34 cases green.
